violations.text: Molluscan shellfish tags were not dated for the last date of use/service. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Raw beef was observed stored over seafood items in the walk-in cooler and not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Beef was moved for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Per the PIC, all equipment and utensils are to be properly sanitized in the 3 bay sink after washing and rinsing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The following items were observed not cooled properly in the walk-in cooler... - Hashbrown potatoes from previous breakfast service were observed at 46 degrees Fahrenheit - Fruit Salad (Watermelon, honey dew melon, cantaloupe, etc.) cut earlier same morning for breakfast service was observed at 55 degrees Fahrenheit Based on time items prepared and cooled, food items were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Fruit salad and hashbrown potatoes from earlier breakfast service were observed cooling in the walk-in cooler in plastic wrap covered pans. Food items are to be cooled spread out in thin layers in shallow pans and left uncovered, if possible contamination can be prevented, to allow for rapid cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

A spray bottle with Chlorine sanitizer solution (labeled bleach/water) was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. The bleach/water mixture was adjusted to the proper range of 50-100ppm at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025
Several Spray bottles were observed to have faintly/worn labeled names. Bottles are to be clearly marked with the common name of the chemical contents. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025

Single service items were observed not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or inverted to prevent possible contamination. If packaging is removed, remaining items are to be stored inverted. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025
The sprayer/faucet to the 3 bay sink was observed to be leaking/dripping between times of use. Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine/bleach sanitizing solution for the low temp dish machine and the bleach/water spray bottle(s). New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2025

At the time of inspection, the new Outdoor Bar area was observed to be lacking a hand-washing sink. Hand Sink is to be installed to facilitate proper handwashing at times of use. New Violation. Correct By: 04/09/2024
Cases of food items were observed stored on the floor in the storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 04/09/2024

At the time of inspection, the new Outdoor Bar area was observed to be lacking a 3 Bay Sink. A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and SANITIZING EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS. New Violation. Correct By: 04/09/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2024
